headline: Napoleon Routed at Waterloo; Emperor's Army Broken by Allied Forces
dispatch: Allied forces under the Duke of Wellington and Prussian Field Marshal Blucher have shattered Napoleon Bonaparte's army on the plains of Waterloo in present-day Belgium. The French imperial guard, long considered invincible, was repulsed and routed in the late afternoon fighting. Bonaparte fled the field as his forces dissolved in chaos, effectively ending his bid to reclaim mastery of Europe.
answer: Napoleon loses his final battle at Waterloo, 1815
